label: <DEL> or first y/v/j at step >=3, in sequences starting with 1/p/o/f/z/0/q
explanation: Fires almost only at the <DEL> step (60% of mass, but only 7.5% of <DEL> steps) and on the first occurrence of certain original-phase letters, mainly y (23% of mass), then v, j, i, g, at steps 3-9. It never fires at t<2 and almost never in the copy phase (0.4% of mass, only at recall_idx 1). Whether it fires depends strongly on the sequence prefix. Firing is enriched when the first token is 1, p, o, f, z, 0 or q (3-4x lift), and the strongest examples also have c, q, w or x at positions 1-2 (e.g. 1 f c c v y ... <DEL>). It fires more in shorter sequences and at early positions (t=4-5 peak). Repeated tokens (in_first=0) rarely fire it. The predicate (<DEL>, or first y/v/j at t>=3, gated on first token) gets about 0.71 dev mass recall but only about 0.27 precision. The dependence on which earlier tokens appeared looks distributed, and simple prefix-set conditions do not capture it.
